sources.entry: Ever Gauzy - Open business management platform for collaborative, on-demand and sharing economies (ERP/CRM/HRM/ATS/PM). (Demo, Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Docker/Nodejs

summary.one_liner: Ever Gauzy is an open-source business management platform combining ERP, CRM, HRM, applicant tracking, project management and employee time tracking, self-hostable via Docker or Node.js.
summary.what_it_does: Gauzy is a web-based business management suite covering HR (employee register, onboarding, time off, performance monitoring), CRM (contacts, sales pipelines, proposals), ERP (accounting, invoicing, payments, income and expenses, inventory), applicant tracking with candidate interviews, and project/task management with goals and KPIs. Employee time tracking includes timesheets, activity tracking and a desktop timer app that can take screenshots and monitor activity. It exposes headless APIs and ships with a Server app (API plus SQLite or external PostgreSQL), a Desktop App (UI, API and SQLite in one package) and a Desktop Timer App. The README lists PostgreSQL and MySQL as recommended production databases and names optional components such as Redis, OpenSearch, MinIO, Jitsu and Cube. The stack is TypeScript, NestJS, Nx, Angular and TypeORM/MikroORM/Knex.
use_cases: Track employee work hours and timesheets
Manage clients, leads and sales pipelines
Run applicant tracking and candidate interviews
Manage projects, tasks and team time off
Self-host an all-in-one business back office
how_to_run: Clone the repo and install Docker Compose v2.20 or newer
Demo: run `docker-compose -f docker-compose.demo.yml up` and open the web UI in a browser
Production: set JWT, session and DEMO_*_PASSWORD secrets in `.env.compose`, then run `docker-compose up -d`
Manual: install Node.js 26.x and Yarn 1.22.x, run `yarn bootstrap`, then `yarn start`
Alternatively download the Server or Desktop App for Windows, Mac or Linux from the official Downloads page
notable: Includes a dedicated desktop time tracker with screenshots and activity monitoring
Combines ERP, CRM, HRM, ATS and project management in one platform
Headless APIs allow other front ends to connect
Supports many databases through TypeORM and MikroORM
Ships Docker Compose files for demo, production and full-infrastructure builds
caveats: The README says the hosted SaaS is in Alpha testing and should be used cautiously
Docs are marked work-in-progress, and production is recommended on Kubernetes rather than Docker Compose
Production setup requires several mandatory secrets and passwords, and the full Docker Compose stack runs many infrastructure services
The default license is the Community Edition; Small Business and Enterprise editions are commercial
